title: Wallet Ownership and Control Workpaper - DemoCo Treasury LLC
conclusionSummary: For 2026-Q2, the two included wallets are mapped to DemoCo Treasury LLC; the self-custody Ethereum wallet has proof-of-control evidence; the Bitcoin custodian account is supported by a custodian statement; period-end balances tie to source evidence; and the one excluded wallet has a documented exclusion rationale. Proof-of-control evidence demonstrates control of a key at a point in time and does not, by itself, establish legal or beneficial ownership.
